latest.text:
Medvedev beat Tiafoe 6–3, 6–4 in the group stage to pick up a win in his second group match in Turin. It was the first appearance of Tiafoe at this event.

The start was not easy for Medvedev. He was the first to come under pressure and had to save two break points. He held, broke soon after and took the first set 6–3. Tiafoe came out aggressive in the second set and showed fine touch near the net. Medvedev stayed calm, broke late in the set and served out the match. Whatever happens next, he enjoys being here: "The Finals is a great tournament because whenever you finish it is great because you have some rest at the end of the season. But if you continue playing that is great because I love to win, …" Today he got that win.

Medvedev was at his best when it mattered most. He saved every break point he faced and his defence kept Tiafoe chasing. His serve was the base of it, with 76% of first serves in against his 65% average on hard. The score stayed close only because Tiafoe saved most of the break points against him.

A win that says a lot about Medvedev's experience on this stage, against a player new to it. He won this event in London in 2020 and played like a man who knows it well. Up next: his last group match.
